sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: For weeks, the United States has been building up an enormous military presence around Iran.
sentences.zh: 数周以来，美国一直在伊朗周边集结庞大的军事力量。

sentences.en: Even as negotiators from both countries plan to meet later this week, in the hopes of finding a diplomatic off-ramp to the escalating tensions.
sentences.zh: 尽管两国谈判代表计划在本周晚些时候会面，希望能为日益紧张的局势找到外交出路。

sentences.en: Now, as President Trump signals a potential attack, our colleague David Sanger explains what the president hopes to achieve through military action and why he's chosen this moment.
sentences.zh: 现在，随着特朗普总统发出可能发动袭击的信号，我们的同事大卫·桑格将解释总统希望通过军事行动实现什么目标，以及他为何选择在这个时刻采取行动。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, February 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月24日，星期二。

sentences.en: David Sanger, welcome back to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 大卫·桑格，欢迎回到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Rachel, great to be with you.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋，很高兴能和你在一起。

sentences.en: The last time we talked about Iran on the show, we were in the middle of this brutal crackdown on anti-government protesters who were protesting the regime.
sentences.zh: 我们上次在节目中谈论伊朗时，正值伊朗政府对反政府抗议者进行残酷镇压期间。

sentences.en: And at the time, there was a huge question about whether the United States would take some kind of military action.
sentences.zh: 当时，关于美国是否会采取某种军事行动存在巨大的疑问。

sentences.en: That obviously did not happen.
sentences.zh: 显然那并没有发生。

sentences.en: But in the weeks since, we have seen this massive military buildup in the region.
sentences.zh: 但在随后的几周里，我们看到了该地区大规模的军事集结。

sentences.en: So, David, can you just start by describing what that buildup looks like and what we understand about what exactly is going on in this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么，大卫，你能先描述一下这种集结是什么样的，以及我们对目前正在发生的事情了解多少吗？

sentences.en: Well, Rachel, the buildup is the largest we've seen in the Middle East since the run-up to the war in Iraq in 2003.
sentences.zh: 嗯，瑞秋，这是我们自2003年伊拉克战争前夕以来在这一地区看到的最大规模集结。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: There are two aircraft carriers in the region, the Abraham Lincoln and the Gerald R.
sentences.zh: 该地区有两艘航空母舰，分别是“亚伯拉罕·林肯”号和“杰拉尔德·R·福特”号。

sentences.en: Ford, which has come back from Venezuela.
sentences.zh: “福特”号刚从委内瑞拉回来。

sentences.en: There are fighter jets, refueling capability, bombers.
sentences.zh: 还有战斗机、空中加油能力和轰炸机。

sentences.en: They are all taking up positions from Jordan all through our bases in the region.
sentences.zh: 它们正从约旦到我们在该地区的基地全面部署到位。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, there's the last gasp of a diplomatic track underway.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，外交途径正在进行最后的努力。

sentences.en: On Thursday, we expect that the Iranians will be meeting with the two main American negotiators,
sentences.zh: 我们预计周四伊朗人将与两位主要的美国谈判代表会面，

sentences.en: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, to present a package that might satisfy President Trump's demands.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳，以提交一份可能满足特朗普总统要求的方案。

sentences.en: But the president has made clear that he is thinking of everything from a limited strike on Iran to what could be a much larger military action that could take days or weeks.
sentences.zh: 但总统已经明确表示，他正在考虑各种方案，从对伊朗进行有限打击，到可能持续数天或数周的更大规模军事行动。

sentences.en: You mentioned that the president has made demands.
sentences.zh: 你提到总统提出了要求。

sentences.en: What are those demands exactly?
sentences.zh: 这些要求具体是什么？

sentences.en: Like, what does the United States want right now?
sentences.zh: 也就是说，美国现在想要什么？

sentences.en: And what are they trying to achieve either through these talks or through any kind of potential military action?
sentences.zh: 他们试图通过这些会谈或任何潜在的军事行动实现什么目标？

sentences.en: You know, there's a bit of a murkiness on this issue.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这个问题上有点模糊。

sentences.en: Usually when presidents get to a situation like this, they're pretty clear about what it is they are seeking.
sentences.zh: 通常当总统遇到这种情况时，他们会很清楚自己想要什么。

sentences.en: But in this case, the president has not been clear.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，总统一直没有说清楚。

sentences.en: The president's offered a dizzying array of rationales for the military action that we may see.
sentences.zh: 总统为我们可能看到的军事行动提供了一系列令人眼花缭乱的理由。

sentences.en: Donald Trump is urging Iranians to keep protesting, saying...
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普敦促伊朗人继续抗议，他说……

sentences.en: If Iran shoots and violently kills peaceful protesters, which is their custom, the United States of America will come to their rescue.
sentences.zh: 如果伊朗开枪暴力杀害和平抗议者，这是他们的惯例，美利坚合众国将会去营救他们。

sentences.en: He's talked about supporting the protesters, of course.
sentences.zh: 他当然谈到了支持抗议者。

sentences.en: We talked about Hamas and we talked about disarmament.
sentences.zh: 我们谈到了哈马斯，也谈到了裁军。

sentences.en: He's talked about cutting off support for the proxies, like Hezbollah and Hamas.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了切断对代理人的支持，比如真主党和哈马斯。

sentences.en: There's nothing that would do more good for this part of the world than for Iran's leaders to renounce terrorists, stop threatening their neighbors,
sentences.zh: 对于这个地区来说，没有什么比伊朗领导人放弃恐怖分子、停止威胁邻国、

sentences.en: quit funding their militant proxies.
sentences.zh: 停止资助其武装代理人更有益的事情了。

sentences.en: He's talked about taking out Iran's missile capability, the missiles that can reach Israel.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了消除伊朗的导弹能力，即那些能够打击以色列的导弹。

sentences.en: These are all conventional weapons, but they pose a big threat to a major American ally.
sentences.zh: 这些都是常规武器，但它们对美国的一个主要盟友构成了巨大威胁。

sentences.en: And then, of course, there's the one big reason he keeps returning to.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有一个他不断提及的重要原因。

sentences.en: You can't have peace in the Middle East if they have a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 如果他们拥有核武器，中东就不可能有和平。

sentences.en: And they can't have a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 他们不能拥有核武器。

sentences.en: And that is going after the remnants of Iran's nuclear portfolio.
sentences.zh: 这就是要清除伊朗核计划的残余部分。

sentences.en: I hope they're not trying to build up again, because if they are, we're going to have no choice but very quickly to eradicate that buildup.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们没有试图重建，因为如果他们有，我们将别无选择，只能非常迅速地根除这种重建。

sentences.en: The nuclear portfolio, we should mention, which the president had previously claimed that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们应该提到，总统之前曾声称美国

sentences.en: had wiped out back in the summer.
sentences.zh: 在夏天就已经摧毁了核计划。

sentences.en: That's right, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 没错，瑞秋。

sentences.en: And, you know, just to wind back the clock for a moment, you may remember that in June, there was a 12-day war that the Israelis initiated against Iran.
sentences.zh: 你知道，让我们回顾一下，你可能记得在六月，以色列对伊朗发动了一场为期12天的战争。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that it ended with a U.S.
sentences.zh: 那场战争以美国对伊朗几十年来建立的三个主要核浓缩设施的袭击而告终。

sentences.en: attack on the three major nuclear enrichment sites that Iran has built up over the decades.
sentences.zh: 这三个地点只有美国空军有能力使用钻地弹深入地下进行摧毁。

sentences.en: And these were three sites that only the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在执行任务的过程中，他们最终将伊朗的浓缩铀库存埋在了废墟之下，

sentences.en: Air Force had the capability with bunker busters to get down deep enough to try to destroy.
sentences.zh: 这些铀的纯度仅略低于制造核武器所需的水平。

sentences.en: And in the course of doing that, they ended up burying under the rubble Iran's stockpile
sentences.zh: 为了明确起见，在美国进行了那次完整的行动之后，现在还有什么可以通过某种军事行动来打击的目标吗？

sentences.en: of enriched uranium that was enriched to a purity just shy of what you would need to make a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 嗯，目标仍然存在。

sentences.en: And just to be clear, after the U.S.
sentences.zh: 有些地方伊朗制造了核离心机，即那些以超音速旋转并生产铀的机器。

sentences.en: conducted that whole campaign, what would be left now to hit through some kind of military action?
sentences.zh: 你可以摧毁其中一些目标。

sentences.en: Well, there are still targets.
sentences.zh: 大卫，美国上次对伊朗采取军事行动时，是与以色列密切协调的，以色列显然是我们该地区最大的盟友。

sentences.en: There are places where the Iranians have made nuclear centrifuges, the machines that spin at supersonic speeds and produce uranium.
sentences.zh: （注：此编号对应原文第72条，因原文编号跳跃，此处补齐）

sentences.en: You could wipe out some of those targets.
sentences.zh: （注：此编号对应原文第73条，因原文编号跳跃，此处补齐）

sentences.en: David, the last time that the United States took a military action against Iran, it was in close coordination with Israel, which is obviously our biggest ally in the region.
sentences.zh: （注：此编号对应原文第74条，因原文编号跳跃，此处补齐）

sentences.en: They have grave concerns about Iran's nuclear and missile prograMs.
sentences.zh: 他们对伊朗的核计划和导弹计划深感忧虑。

sentences.en: What do we know about Israel's involvement this time around?
sentences.zh: 关于以色列这次的参与，我们了解多少？

sentences.en: Well, we know that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has been talking frequently to President Trump.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们知道本雅明·内塔尼亚胡总理一直在与特朗普总统频繁通话。

sentences.en: He came for a visit about two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 他大约两周前刚来访问过。

sentences.en: And what little leaked out from that session indicated that the Israeli government was quite concerned that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 从那次会谈中泄露出的点滴信息表明，以色列政府非常担心美国

sentences.en: wasn't paying enough attention to the missiles.
sentences.zh: 对导弹问题关注不够。

sentences.en: And it's the missiles that can reach Israel that actually pierced the missile defenses last time and struck some civilian targets and killed some Israelis.
sentences.zh: 正是那些能打到以色列的导弹，上次穿透了导弹防御系统，击中了一些平民目标，并造成了一些以色列人伤亡。

sentences.en: And, you know, at the same time, the president has got some people in his ear, including Iran hardliners in Congress, saying,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，与此同时，总统身边也有一些人在吹风，包括国会里的伊朗强硬派，他们说：

sentences.en: you will never have an opportunity like you've got right now, that Iran and Ayatollah Khamenei have never been weaker.
sentences.zh: 你永远不会再有像现在这样的机会了，伊朗和哈梅内伊最高领袖从未如此虚弱。

sentences.en: They're economically on the ropes.
sentences.zh: 他们的经济已经到了崩溃的边缘。

sentences.en: There are protests in the streets.
sentences.zh: 街头到处都是抗议活动。

sentences.en: People are sick of their government and the repression surrounding it.
sentences.zh: 人们厌倦了他们的政府以及随之而来的压迫。

sentences.en: And that after the war in June, they have never fully recovered militarily.
sentences.zh: 而且在六月份的战争之后，他们在军事上从未完全恢复元气。

sentences.en: Just take the moment to push them over the cliff.
sentences.zh: 现在正是推他们一把，让他们彻底垮台的时候。

sentences.en: So the president may have in the back of his mind a great desire to seize the moment.
sentences.zh: 所以总统内心深处可能非常渴望抓住这个时机。

sentences.en: But at the same time, this is risky business.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，这事风险很大。

sentences.en: This is a country of 90 million people.
sentences.zh: 这是一个拥有9000万人口的国家。

sentences.en: They have considerable ability not only to strike back with missiles, but with a terror network that runs throughout Europe and to some degree has shown some capability
sentences.zh: 他们不仅有相当强的能力用导弹进行反击，还有一个遍布欧洲的恐怖网络，并且在某种程度上已经表现出

sentences.en: to operate inside the United States.
sentences.zh: 在美国境内行动的能力。

sentences.en: They've got significant cyber capabilities as well.
sentences.zh: 他们也拥有强大的网络攻击能力。

sentences.en: So it's hardly guaranteed that this is going to be a like one night attack, like you saw in June when they went after the nuclear sites.
sentences.zh: 所以，这很难保证会像六月份打击核设施时那样，只是一次性的夜间袭击。

sentences.en: It's very possible that the Iranians could respond.
sentences.zh: 伊朗人很有可能会做出回应。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: then escalates.
sentences.zh: 随后升级行动。

sentences.en: The Iranians then escalate.
sentences.zh: 伊朗人接着升级反击。

sentences.en: And you're into a bigger conflict than anyone wants to see happen in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 然后你就陷入了一场没人希望在中东发生的更大规模冲突中。

sentences.en: Okay, so it sounds like there are a lot of people in the president's ear right now.
sentences.zh: 好的，听起来总统身边现在有很多人的声音。

sentences.en: There's Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 有内塔尼亚胡。

sentences.en: There are the Iran hawks in Congress.
sentences.zh: 有国会里的伊朗鹰派。

sentences.en: But one thing that I think has been very top of mind, at least since the protests in January,
sentences.zh: 但我认为，至少自一月份的抗议活动以来，大家最关心的一件事，

sentences.en: is regime change and how a lot of these goals that you mentioned that the administration could be
sentences.zh: 就是政权更迭，以及你提到的政府可能正在考虑的许多目标，

sentences.en: considering right now could lead to that, depending on what kind of military action they take.
sentences.zh: 根据他们采取的军事行动类型，可能会导致政权更迭。

sentences.en: Is that part of the calculation here?
sentences.zh: 这是这里的考量因素之一吗？

sentences.en: We have to assume that it's one of the biggest parts of the calculation.
sentences.zh: 我们必须假设这是考量因素中最重要的一部分。

sentences.en: But the fact of the matter is the president has stopped just short of that.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，总统并没有走到那一步。

sentences.en: And when the topic came up with Secretary of State Marco Rubio and some Senate testimony last month,
sentences.zh: 当上个月国务卿马尔科·卢比奥在参议院作证时提到这个话题时，

sentences.en: he said, well, this would be big and complicated and we'd have to give a lot of thought to what that would look like.
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，这会是一件大事，很复杂，我们必须仔细考虑那会是什么样子。

sentences.en: Well, a little late to come to the conclusion we have to think that through.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在才得出结论说我们需要仔细考虑，有点太晚了。

sentences.en: The fact of the matter is the government of the United States has been thinking about regime change in Iran for decades.
sentences.zh: 事实是，美国政府几十年来一直在考虑伊朗的政权更迭问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So there are a couple of big questions here, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有几个大问题，雷切尔。

sentences.en: The first is, can you bring about regime change with an air campaign?
sentences.zh: 首先，你能通过空中战役实现政权更迭吗？

sentences.en: It's not clear at all that that's necessarily going to work.
sentences.zh: 完全不清楚这是否一定会奏效。

sentences.en: Second, if it does work, what's the assurance that the government that would come in would be any friendlier to the United States?
sentences.zh: 其次，如果奏效了，有什么保证说上台的政府会对美国更友好呢？

sentences.en: It could just be another repressive regime.
sentences.zh: 它可能只是另一个压迫性政权。

sentences.en: And the other risk, of course, is that this could just escalate into a much larger regional conflict.
sentences.zh: 当然，另一个风险是，这可能会升级为一场更大规模的地区冲突。

sentences.en: It should be entirely understandable if the Iranians decided that the regime was at risk and they were going to throw everything into the retaliation.
sentences.zh: 如果伊朗人认为政权岌岌可危，并决定孤注一掷进行报复，那是完全可以理解的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的。

sentences.en: David, when we think about a potential military strike in Iran and what that might mean for regime change, I am, of course, reminded about the recent action that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 大卫，当我们思考对伊朗进行潜在军事打击以及这对政权更迭意味着什么时，我自然会想起美国最近

sentences.en: took in Venezuela when it removed the president, Nicolas Maduro.
sentences.zh: 在委内瑞拉采取的行动，当时他们罢免了总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗。

sentences.en: My sense is, at least, that that really caused other countries to sit up a little straighter in the face of U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的感觉是，至少这确实让其他国家在面对美国压力时，

sentences.en: pressure.
sentences.zh: 稍微挺直了腰杆。

sentences.en: And so I wonder whether that is coming into play here at all with how the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，这是否在某种程度上影响了美国

sentences.en: is interacting with Iran in this moment.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻与伊朗的互动方式。

sentences.en: Well, Rachel, I think it's definitely part of the calculation.
sentences.zh: 嗯，雷切尔，我认为这绝对是考量的一部分。

sentences.en: I mean, first of all, there is a just overall similarity to the gunboat diplomacy here, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，首先，这与“炮舰外交”在整体上确实有相似之处，对吧？

sentences.en: You mass a naval fleet off the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 你在海岸外集结海军舰队。

sentences.en: You issue a set of demands.
sentences.zh: 你提出一系列要求。

sentences.en: And if the demands are not met, you then use that military force to compel the country to change the way you want it to change.
sentences.zh: 如果要求得不到满足，你就利用军事力量强迫该国按照你想要的方式改变。

sentences.en: But there's also a real difference here as well.
sentences.zh: 但这里也有一个真正的区别。

sentences.en: Because in Venezuela, it was a very targeted operation.
sentences.zh: 因为在委内瑞拉，那是一次非常有针对性的行动。

sentences.en: They were aiming for one guy, Maduro.
sentences.zh: 他们的目标是一个人，马杜罗。

sentences.en: And when they pulled him out of there and sent him off to the Brooklyn Detention Center, they left the rest of his government fully in place.
sentences.zh: 当他们把他抓走并送往布鲁克林拘留中心时，他们让他的其余政府成员完全留任。

sentences.en: In Iran, however, it seems very unlikely that that model would work.
sentences.zh: 然而在伊朗，这种模式似乎不太可能奏效。

sentences.en: First of all, it's a much larger country.
sentences.zh: 首先，那是一个大得多的国家。

sentences.en: It's 90 million people.
sentences.zh: 这可是9000万人口的国家。

sentences.en: Second, it's a lot more complex.
sentences.zh: 其次，情况要复杂得多。

sentences.en: It's a lot better armed.
sentences.zh: 它的武装力量也强得多。

sentences.en: It's got air defenses that Maduro never had.
sentences.zh: 它拥有马杜罗从未有过的防空系统。

sentences.en: It's got a population that may go along with the removal of the government, but also has bitter memories of CIA efforts to bring about coups in Iran in the 1950s.
sentences.zh: 它的人口或许会支持推翻现政府，但他们对20世纪50年代中情局在伊朗策划政变的行径也记忆犹新。

sentences.en: And finally, if the U.S.
sentences.zh: 最后，如果美国

sentences.en: was successful, it's not clear that you could leave the existing government in place the way they have in Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 真的成功了，也不清楚是否能像在委内瑞拉那样，让现有的政府架构维持原样。

sentences.en: You'd have to take out that entire structure run by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
sentences.zh: 你必须铲除伊斯兰革命卫队运作的整个结构。

sentences.en: You'd have to eliminate almost all of those loyalists to Ayatollah Khamenei.
sentences.zh: 你必须清除几乎所有哈梅内伊的忠诚拥护者。

sentences.en: So it's not clear that you would have someone in place to go run the country and to respond to those American demands.
sentences.zh: 所以，并不清楚是否有人能接手管理国家并回应美国的那些要求。

sentences.en: Okay, so given the fact that a military action would be extremely complicated in Iran,
sentences.zh: 好的，鉴于在伊朗采取军事行动将极其复杂，

sentences.en: what would a more quote-unquote limited strike look like that the United States is actually considering?
sentences.zh: 美国目前真正考虑的那种所谓的“有限打击”会是什么样？

sentences.en: It's a good question, because there are all kinds of targets.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题，因为目标多种多样。

sentences.en: They could go after the besiege, which is the local militia groups that have been used to put down the protesters.
sentences.zh: 他们可以针对“巴斯基”民兵组织，也就是那些被用来镇压抗议者的当地民兵团体。

sentences.en: That way, at least, the president could say he's making good on his commitment.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，总统至少可以说他兑现了自己的承诺。

sentences.en: They could go after the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
sentences.zh: 他们可以针对伊斯兰革命卫队。

sentences.en: And you may remember that back in 2020, in his first term, President Trump ordered a drone strike on the head of the Quds Force, the most elite part of the Iranian military,
sentences.zh: 你可能还记得，2020年特朗普总统在第一个任期内，下令用无人机袭击了伊朗军队中最精锐的“圣城旅”指挥官，

sentences.en: and managed to kill him.
sentences.zh: 并成功将其击毙。

sentences.en: So you could imagine more attacks on the leadership of the IRGC.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象，针对伊斯兰革命卫队领导层的袭击会更多。

sentences.en: You could imagine attacks that were just limited to those missiles and missile sites and the launchers that Israel's most worried about.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，袭击仅限于以色列最担心的那些导弹、导弹基地和发射装置。

sentences.en: But all of those would gain mostly a tactical advantage.
sentences.zh: 但所有这些大多只能获得战术上的优势。

sentences.en: If the government didn't change, the military leaders will get replaced.
sentences.zh: 如果政府不更迭，军事领导人就会被替换。

sentences.en: Eventually, Iran will build more missiles or buy them.
sentences.zh: 最终，伊朗会制造或购买更多的导弹。

sentences.en: So the real question is, are you just mowing the lawn or are you bringing about real change?
sentences.zh: 所以真正的问题是，你只是在“修剪草坪”，还是在带来真正的改变？

sentences.en: How concerned is Iran about all of this or any of this?
sentences.zh: 伊朗对这一切有多担心？

sentences.en: Well, Rachel, the Iranians have made it pretty clear they're deeply concerned.
sentences.zh: 嗯，瑞秋，伊朗人已经非常明确地表示他们深感担忧。

sentences.en: I mean, first of all, we've seen them burying and reinforcing some nuclear-related sites or suspected nuclear-related sites that hadn't been hit back in June.
sentences.zh: 我是说，首先，我们看到他们掩埋并加固了一些核相关设施，或者说是疑似核相关设施，这些设施在六月份时还没有受到打击。

sentences.en: Second,
sentences.zh: 其次，

sentences.en: they've moved a good number of their missiles and other arms to the borders where they could more easily reach American bases or Israel to make the point that they're going to get some shots off if they get attacked.
sentences.zh: 他们已经将相当数量的导弹和其他武器转移到了边境，在那里他们可以更容易地打击美国基地或以色列，以此表明如果受到攻击，他们会进行反击。

sentences.en: Thirdly, there's the strange action by Ayatollah Khamenei, who is 86 years old and presumably has some succession plans anyway.
sentences.zh: 第三，哈梅内伊采取了奇怪的行动，他已经86岁了，本来应该有一些继任计划。

sentences.en: But as we've reported in the Times, he's deepened those in recent times.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们在《时报》报道的那样，他最近加深了这些计划。

sentences.en: So the Supreme Leader is clearly aware that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以最高领袖显然意识到美国

sentences.en: may be going for regime change and he wants an insurance policy against that.
sentences.zh: 可能正在寻求政权更迭，他想要一份保险单来应对这种情况。

sentences.en: But these are all the kind of preparations we've not really seen the Iranians take at this level before.
sentences.zh: 但这些都是我们以前从未真正见过伊朗人达到这种程度的准备工作。

sentences.en: At the same time, though, of course, there are these diplomatic talks.
sentences.zh: 不过与此同时，当然还有这些外交谈判。

sentences.en: What kind of off-ramp, if any, is being considered right now so that we do not see this kind of escalation?
sentences.zh: 目前是否正在考虑任何形式的“下台阶”方案，以避免这种升级？

sentences.en: Well, the talks have been stymied a bit by the problem that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谈判受到了一些阻碍，因为美国

sentences.en: is demanding that there is no uranium enrichment.
sentences.zh: 要求伊朗完全停止铀浓缩。

sentences.en: In other words, that Iran get completely out of the business of making any nuclear fuel.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，就是让伊朗彻底退出制造任何核燃料的业务。

sentences.en: And there's an interesting idea that's been floated,
sentences.zh: 有一个有趣的提议被提了出来，

sentences.en: which is to allow the Iranians to have a very limited enrichment capability purely for medical and medical research-related purposes.
sentences.zh: 那就是允许伊朗拥有非常有限的浓缩能力，纯粹用于医疗和医学研究目的。

sentences.en: It's got a nice humanitarian tone to it.
sentences.zh: 这听起来很有“人道主义”色彩。

sentences.en: It would be basically allowing the Iranians to produce fuel for a small research reactor that's been in Tehran since 1967, when, in one of those great ironies of history,
sentences.zh: 这基本上是允许伊朗为一个自1967年以来就一直在德黑兰的小型研究堆生产燃料，当时，在历史的讽刺巧合中，

sentences.en: the United States gave the reactor to the Shah of Iran.
sentences.zh: 美国将这个反应堆送给了伊朗国王。

sentences.en: And it's used mostly for production of pharmaceuticals.
sentences.zh: 它主要用于生产药品。

sentences.en: It's useful for cancer treatments and so forth.
sentences.zh: 它对癌症治疗等很有用。

sentences.en: And this would allow the Iranians to say, we're still enriching, and allow the United States to say, we've stopped all their nuclear weapons activity.
sentences.zh: 这将使伊朗可以说：“我们仍在进行浓缩”，并允许美国说：“我们已经阻止了他们所有的核武器活动”。

sentences.en: But it's not clear the Iranians will give up that much capability.
sentences.zh: 但不清楚伊朗人是否会放弃那么多的能力。

sentences.en: And it's not clear that President Trump would accept any continued enrichment of any kind for any purpose.
sentences.zh: 也不清楚特朗普总统是否会接受任何目的下的任何形式的持续浓缩。

sentences.en: Given all of that, David, is it possible that the military buildup that we've seen is not necessarily an alternative to diplomacy,
sentences.zh: 大卫，鉴于这一切，我们所看到的军事集结是否不一定是外交的替代品，

sentences.en: but actually something that the president is using to sort of strengthen his hand diplomatically?
sentences.zh: 而是总统用来加强其外交筹码的手段？

sentences.en: Like, could he be using this threat of the military action as leverage to push for a diplomatic solution at the talks later this week?
sentences.zh: 比如，他是否在利用这种军事行动的威胁作为杠杆，来推动本周晚些时候的谈判达成外交解决方案？

sentences.en: Like, it's very possible.
sentences.zh: 这很有可能。

sentences.en: That's the diplomacy part of gunboat diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 这就是“炮舰外交”中的外交部分。

sentences.en: Of course, the flip side of that, Rachel, is if you have spent hundreds of millions, if not billions of dollars, assembling a huge force off a country's coast,
sentences.zh: 当然，瑞秋，其反面是，如果你已经花费了数亿甚至数十亿美元，在一个国家的海岸外集结了一支庞大的部队，

sentences.en: the temptation to go use that is extraordinarily high.
sentences.zh: 那么使用它的诱惑力是非常大的。

sentences.en: And if his real goal here is regime change, then he may not really be that interested in a diplomatic solution, because a diplomatic solution would, if anything,
sentences.zh: 如果他在这里的真正目标是政权更迭，那么他可能对外交解决方案并不真正感兴趣，因为外交解决方案如果说有什么影响的话，

sentences.en: bolster the existing regime.
sentences.zh: 那就是巩固了现有的政权。

sentences.en: It would remain in place.
sentences.zh: 它会继续存在。

sentences.en: Just to take a step back here, the United States has viewed Iran as a threat for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 退一步说，多年来美国一直将伊朗视为威胁。

sentences.en: So, on the one hand, it makes sense that it would continue to be a priority.
sentences.zh: 所以，一方面，它继续作为优先事项是有道理的。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, during the second Trump administration, the United States has really kind of laid out this worldview of spheres of influence,
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，在特朗普第二任期内，美国确实提出了这种“势力范围”的世界观，

sentences.en: which we've talked about a lot on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中讨论过很多次。

sentences.en: The idea that the great powers can carve up the world and consider sections of it to be under their own purview.
sentences.zh: 即大国可以瓜分世界，并将部分地区视为自己的势力范围。

sentences.en: We've seen from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们从美国

sentences.en: side that that has meant the Western Hemisphere.
sentences.zh: 方面看到，这意味着西半球。

sentences.en: So, I wonder where you feel like the Middle East fits into that worldview.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇你觉得中东在那种世界观中处于什么位置。

sentences.en: Rachel, you're exactly right.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋，你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: This does not fit comfortably into the president's national security strategy that came out in November.
sentences.zh: 这与总统11月份发布的国家安全战略并不完全契合。

sentences.en: On the one hand, as you suggest, American presidents have been pushing back on Iran and the Iranian nuclear program for decades, ever since the Iran hostage crisis, right?
sentences.zh: 一方面，正如你所暗示的，自伊朗人质危机以来，几十年来美国总统一直在抵制伊朗及其核计划，对吧？

sentences.en: Which came right after the Iranian revolution in 1979.
sentences.zh: 那是在1979年伊朗革命之后发生的。

sentences.en: The United States has sabotaged the Iranian nuclear program over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，美国一直在破坏伊朗的核计划。

sentences.en: It's mounted some of the most sophisticated cyber attacks in history against Iran's nuclear infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 它针对伊朗的核基础设施发动了历史上一些最复杂的网络攻击。

sentences.en: So, there's always been a consistent effort to push back the day when Iran could get a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 因此，一直有一种持续的努力来推迟伊朗获得核武器的那一天。

sentences.en: And if you view it that way, then President Trump, in what he's doing today,
sentences.zh: 如果你从这个角度看，那么特朗普总统今天的所作所为，

sentences.en: is escalating and expanding what has been a long-running American policy across Democratic and Republican administrations.
sentences.zh: 是在升级和扩大一项跨越民主党和共和党政府的长期美国政策。

sentences.en: But if you view it in the context of his national security strategy, well, Iran isn't exactly in the Western Hemisphere, right?
sentences.zh: 但如果你从他的国家安全战略背景来看，嗯，伊朗并不完全在西半球，对吧？

sentences.en: And so, he may just be seeing a moment to deal with a longtime adversary that is going through a period of remarkable military, economic, and political weakness.
sentences.zh: 所以，他可能只是看到了一个机会，去对付一个正处于军事、经济和政治极其虚弱时期的长期对手。

sentences.en: And I think that's really what's happening here.
sentences.zh: 我认为这才是真正发生的事情。

sentences.en: It's not as if the Iranians are in a position right now to attack us, right?
sentences.zh: 并不是说伊朗人现在有能力攻击我们，对吧？

sentences.en: Their nuclear program has been buried.
sentences.zh: 他们的核计划已经被掩埋了。

sentences.en: Their economy is at a point of near collapse.
sentences.zh: 他们的经济正处于崩溃边缘。

sentences.en: They are not about to go out of their way to pick a conflict with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们绝不会主动去挑起与美国的冲突。

sentences.en: Instead, the president might be engaging in what legal and diplomatic historians call a preventive war, a war where we are strong, our adversary is weak,
sentences.zh: 相反，总统可能正在进行法律和外交历史学家所说的“预防性战争”，即在我们强大、对手虚弱时发动的战争，

sentences.en: and so we're going to hit them now because we've got a good chance.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要现在打击他们，因为我们有很大的胜算。

sentences.en: That is, in international just war theory, considered to be an illegal use of force.
sentences.zh: 在国际正义战争理论中，这被认为是违法的武力使用。

sentences.en: That may not stop the president.
sentences.zh: 这可能无法阻止总统。

sentences.en: The president may believe that he'll go down in history as the one who solved America's long-running conflict with Iran that goes back to 1979.
sentences.zh: 总统可能认为他会作为解决美国自1979年以来与伊朗长期冲突的人而载入史册。

sentences.en: But if the president decides to take military action in the next few days or weeks, I suspect that historians will look back at this moment as a war of choice,
sentences.zh: 但如果总统决定在未来几天或几周内采取军事行动，我怀疑历史学家回顾这一时刻时，会将其视为一场“选择性战争”，

sentences.en: not a war of necessity.
sentences.zh: 而不是一场“必要性战争”。

sentences.en: David Sanger, thank you so much, as always.
sentences.zh: 大卫·桑格，一如既往，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，瑞秋。

sentences.en: Great to be with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你交流。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的消息。

sentences.en: Mexican authorities appeared to have restored order in multiple cities after the killing of a major cartel leader set off a wave of violence that left at least 62 people dead.
sentences.zh: 在一名主要贩毒集团头目被杀引发了一波导致至少62人死亡的暴力浪潮后，墨西哥当局似乎已在多个城市恢复了秩序。

sentences.en: Mexico's most powerful criminal organization, the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, unleashed the chaos after its leader, Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes, or El Mencho,
sentences.zh: 墨西哥最强大的犯罪组织“哈利斯科新一代卡特尔”，在其领导人内梅西奥·奥塞格拉·塞万提斯（又名“埃尔·门乔”）
zh_words: 西奥·奥塞格拉·塞万提斯

sentences.en: died in a military raid on Sunday in western Jalisco state.
sentences.zh: 于周日在西部哈利斯科州的一次军事突袭中死亡后，引发了混乱。

sentences.en: And British police arrested the former ambassador to the United States, Peter Mandelson,
sentences.zh: 英国警方逮捕了前驻美大使彼得·曼德尔森，

sentences.en: following accusations that he had passed on confidential information to the sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 此前有指控称他向性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦泄露了机密信息。

sentences.en: The move comes just days after the arrest of Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor, formerly Prince Andrew, on suspicion of the same offense,
sentences.zh: 此举发生在前安德鲁王子、现安德鲁·蒙巴顿-温莎因涉嫌同样罪行被捕几天后，

sentences.en: and months after Mandelson was fired once the extent of his friendship with Epstein was revealed.
sentences.zh: 而在曼德尔森与爱泼斯坦的友谊程度被曝光后，他几个月前就被解雇了。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Carlos Brieto, Nina Feldman, and Claire Tennisgetter.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由卡洛斯·布里托、尼娜·费尔德曼和克莱尔·坦尼斯盖特制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Maria Byrne and Mark George.
sentences.zh: 由玛丽亚·伯恩和马克·乔治编辑。

sentences.en: Contains music by Marian Lozano, Alicia Baitoup, and Rowan Nemisto, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 包含玛丽安·洛萨诺、艾丽西亚·贝图普和罗文·内米斯托的音乐，由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Eric Schmidt and Mark Mazzetti.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢埃里克·施密特和马克·马泽蒂。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Rachel AbraMs. See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我是瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯。明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要完全遮光才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
